comment: MK3 signature preset pack definitions (SYNTH_PRESET_PACK.md). Parameters are descriptor NAMES resolved against the current firmware code at generation time; values outside a descriptor range or off a discrete step fail the build. PFXS types: 0 BYPASS, 5 OVERDRIVE, 6 FOLDER, 15 HARD CLIP, 16 CHORUS, 20 PITCH SHIFT, 21 ROTARY. PITCH SHIFT semitones are encoded in A as (st+12)/24; ROTARY speed in A as SLOW 0 / FAST 0.5 / BRAKE 1.

presets.name: Minimoog Bass
presets.signature: OSC2 at -12 st square plus SUB WAVE square at 0.55: the sub-octave stack under a driven ladder

presets.name: Minimoog Lead
presets.signature: Dual saw detuned 11 ct with a slow-opening filter (ENV 1.2 oct, attack 10 ms) and drive 1.3

presets.name: SH-101 Bass
presets.signature: Plucky ADSR (D 0.30, S 0.15, R 0.09) on the fixed saw+square-sub voice: the envelope is the whole recipe

presets.name: SH-101 Sequence
presets.signature: Sustain 0 with D 0.11 / R 0.06: a full-decay gate blip distinct from the Bass envelope

presets.name: TB-303 Acid
presets.signature: RESONANCE 0.88 with ENV AMT 0.72 on the saw (WAVE 0); slide/accent are step attributes and intentionally not in the preset

presets.name: Prophet-5 Poly Keys
presets.signature: Gentle 8 ct dual-saw detune, modest filter env 0.7 oct: the polite poly keys voicing

presets.name: Prophet-5 Brass
presets.signature: FILTER ENV 2.8 oct swell from a 1500 Hz floor: the brass attack is the filter, not the amp

presets.name: Jupiter-8 Pad
presets.signature: Two VA pads layered at detune -9/+9 ct and pan -0.4/+0.4: width comes from the layer, not a chorus

presets.name: Juno-106 Pad
presets.signature: Dual pulse with PWM (depth 0.18, rate 0.6) plus PFXS CHORUS: the chorus ships inside the preset

presets.name: Juno-106 Bass
presets.signature: Single-DCO layout per the motif: OSC 2 as PULSE blending with the square sub at 0.6 (SUB WAVE square), PWM off, no chorus: the dry Juno bass counterpart (audit 2026-11-08)

presets.name: JP-8000 Supersaw
presets.signature: Rebuilt as 2x VA layers (each DETUNE 28, layer detune -18/+18 ct, pan -0.3/+0.3) plus PFXS CHORUS: the supersaw spread is now editable values, not a fixed PolySaw voice (audit 2026-11-08)

presets.name: JP-8000 Hypersaw
presets.signature: The Supersaw rebuild widened: VA leaves at DETUNE 38, layer detune -26/+26 ct, chorus mix 0.6 (audit 2026-11-08)

presets.name: Solina String Ensemble
presets.signature: Plaits model 6 (string machine) plus PFXS CHORUS at depth 0.65 / mix 0.8: the ensemble effect is in the snapshot

presets.name: CS-80 Pad
presets.signature: Slowest attacks in the pack (0.9/1.1 s) with layer detune -14/+14 ct and full-width pan

presets.name: MS-20 Scream
presets.signature: Complete version: SVF in HP mode at resonance 1.15 plus PFXS OVERDRIVE: the scream is the resonant high-pass, driven

presets.name: Oberheim SEM Pad
presets.signature: Complete version: FILTER TYPE MORPH parked at 0.5, the notch centre of the LP-to-HP morph

presets.name: DX7 E.Piano
presets.signature: Internal bank patch 32 (E.PIANO 1) unmodified: succeeds factory 'FM6 Electric Piano'

presets.name: DX7 Lately Bass
presets.signature: Bank patch 0 (SOLID BASS, candidate for the Lately program) with ATTACK x0.7 and RELEASE x0.85 tightening (FM6 ATTACK/RELEASE are time multipliers; x1.4 loosened the attack, audit 2026-11-08)

presets.name: DX7 Marimba
presets.signature: Bank patch 49, the program literally named MARIMBA, with RELEASE x0.8 (see report for the deviation from the pack spec text)

presets.name: DX7 Metal Pad
presets.signature: Bank patch 74 (ICE PAD 2) with ATTACK x2 / RELEASE x2, inherited from factory 'FM6 Metal Pad'

presets.name: DX7 Tubular Bell
presets.signature: Bank patch 54 (TUB BELLS) with RELEASE x1.4 for the long bell tail

presets.name: DX7 Wineglass
presets.signature: Bank patch 23 unmodified, the exact values of factory 'FM6 Wineglass' (fm6.values[0]=23, everything else at defaults): the successor round 1 left out

presets.name: Genesis FM Bass
presets.signature: RATIO 0.33 with INDEX 0.62: sub-octave carrier grit (0.5 was the descriptor midpoint and expressed nothing, audit 2026-11-08; confirm by ear)

presets.name: FM Cowbell
presets.signature: RATIO 0.82 with INDEX 0.74: the highest index in the pack, metallic band cluster

presets.name: PPG Wave Pad
presets.signature: POSITION 42 with SCAN DEPTH 22 at rate 0.35: a slow drift through the dark half of the table

presets.name: PPG Wave Bell
presets.signature: POSITION 88 (bright end) with SUSTAIN 0: a pure decay bell, BRIGHTNESS 0.95

presets.name: Microwave Bass
presets.signature: POSITION 10 with SCAN RATE 1.4: fast scan wobble on the darkest waves

presets.name: WT Soft Choir
presets.signature: Factory 'WT Soft Choir' values inherited verbatim (POSITION 48, SCAN DEPTH 3, SCAN RATE 0.1, ATTACK 0.35, RELEASE 2, SUSTAIN 0.7; DECAY/BRIGHTNESS stay at the factory defaults): the pack successor round 1 left out

presets.name: Kawai K5000 Glass
presets.signature: FOCUS 5 / WIDTH 2 additive spectrum with MOTION 0.7, inherited from factory 'ADD Moving Glass'

presets.name: Hammond B-3 Organ
presets.signature: Drawbar-style tapered harmonics (H1 1, H2 0.7, H3 0.85, H4 0.45, H5 0.35, H6 0.15), SUSTAIN 1 (no decay): a registration curve, not a flat stack (audit 2026-11-08)

presets.name: Casio CZ-101 Bass
presets.signature: WAVE 2 (PULSE) with ENV DEPTH 0.5 and sustain 0.2, inherited from factory 'PD Pulse Bass'

presets.name: Casio CZ-101 Pad
presets.signature: WAVE 3 (CURVE) with MOTION 0.6 and a 0.4 s attack swell, inherited from factory 'PD Curved Pad'

presets.name: Prophet VS Vector Pad
presets.signature: Wavetable leaf (scan depth 28) against a VA pulse leaf, panned -0.2/+0.2: two-source vector blend

presets.name: GM Grand Piano
presets.signature: SoundFont bank 0 / program 0: FluidR3 GM 'Yamaha Grand Piano'. Renamed from 'M1 Piano' (audit 2026-11-08): the content is a GM grand, not the Korg M1 piano patch

presets.name: Rings Resonator
presets.signature: MODEL 0 (modal) at polyphony 2 with BRIGHTNESS 0.65 / DAMPING 0.45: bright but quickly damped modes

presets.name: Clouds Texture Pad
presets.signature: Granular MODE 0 fully wet (DRY/WET 1) with DENSITY 0.65 and internal REVERB 0.45; processes the track input bus (INPUT is a track field, not stored in presets)

presets.name: Buchla Bongo
presets.signature: LPG DECAY 0.18, the shortest in the pack, with FOLD only 0.3: a clean percussive bongo

presets.name: Buchla Easel Lead
presets.signature: FOLD 0.85 with PHASE MOD 0.55 and LPG DECAY 0.65: the folded lead counterpart to the Bongo

presets.name: Detroit Chord Stab
presets.signature: Plaits model 14 (chord) with DECAY 0.22: the stab is one short chord-osc envelope

presets.name: Swarm Pad
presets.signature: Plaits model 16 (swarm) with DECAY 0.85: the longest Plaits decay in the pack

presets.name: Robot Voice
presets.signature: Plaits model 15 (speech): the only speech-model preset

presets.name: Game Boy Lead
presets.signature: PITCH FOLLOW 0.85 with NOISE MIX 0.04; CLOCK 0.26 = the Game Boy APU clock 4.194 MHz on the 0-16 MHz display map (audit 2026-11-08; confirm by ear)

presets.name: Frozen Choir
presets.signature: FREEZE 0.92 and WET 0.85 over the pitched demo-slices material: a frozen spectrum wash

presets.name: D-50 LA Piano
presets.signature: 100 ms window of the factory VA-Hit sample as the attack leaf over a decaying additive body (H1 1 / H2 0.55 / H3 0.3)

presets.name: D-50 Fantasia
presets.signature: First 180 ms of the factory FM-Metal sample as a bell attack over a BRIGHTNESS 0.8 wavetable sustain

presets.name: VA-Hit Stab
presets.signature: The factory VA-Hit sample standalone and full-range (START 0 / END 1, no window trim) with RELEASE 60 ms: the D-50 attack leaf as a playable stab in its own right

presets.name: FM-Metal Hit
presets.signature: The factory FM-Metal sample standalone and full-range with EDGE FADE 5 and RELEASE 150 ms: a longer metallic ring-out than the VA-Hit stab

presets.name: Slices Loop
presets.signature: The pitched demo-slices sequence as a looping playable bed: LOOP on with LOOP XFADE 25 ms over the full range, gentle ATTACK 5 / RELEASE 30

presets.name: Mega Moog
presets.signature: Two full Minimoog-style VA stacks layered (four oscillators, two -12 st square subs), detune -4/+4 ct

presets.name: FM+VA Hybrid Keys
presets.signature: DX7 E.PIANO 1 leaf (patch 32) panned -0.1 against a triangle-led VA body at +0.1

presets.name: K5000+CZ Glass Duo
presets.signature: Factory 'Layer Glass Duo' renamed and inherited verbatim: additive leaf (MOTION 0.3) at pan -0.35 / detune -7 against the CZ curve leaf at +0.35 / +7

presets.name: Reese Bass
presets.signature: Rebuilt on the original's lineage (Reese bass was made on a Casio CZ-5000): two PhaseDist SKEW layers detuned -20/+20 ct, DCW sweep (ENV DEPTH 0.6) supplying the filter-like motion the PolySaw version lacked, PFXS FOLDER softened to mix 0.6 (audit 2026-11-08)

presets.name: TR-808 Kick
presets.signature: Analog kick voice with DECAY 0.85, the longest drum decay in the pack, TUNE 0.46

presets.name: TR-909 Kick
presets.signature: Synthetic kick voice with TONE 0.62 (click) and ACCENT 0.95 against a shorter 0.55 decay

presets.name: Simmons SDS Tom
presets.signature: Kick voice retuned to TUNE 0.78: the pitch-drop tom is the kick engine tuned up

presets.name: FM Clave
presets.signature: RATIO 0.78 with INDEX 0.45: drier and shorter than the Cowbell (0.74) by index alone

presets.name: Russian Hardbass Donk
presets.signature: Self-authored custom patch (PATCH -1): algorithm 5 with TWO working pairs (blip pair + sustaining body pair), pitch EG blip +12 st class (L1 64), feedback 0 (ALG 5 feedback targets the silent third pair in the old layout): rebuilt per audit 2026-11-08

presets.name: Hardbass Kick
presets.signature: Synthetic kick with TONE 0.8 and ACCENT 1.0: the hardest click in the pack

presets.name: Hardbass Lead Stab
presets.signature: PolySaw stab at level 0.5 layered with the rebuilt Donk custom FM patch thinned to level 0.3 (Donk rebuild propagated, audit 2026-11-08)

presets.name: Uplifting Trance Lead
presets.signature: Three-source stack: two PolySaw layers at -12/+12 ct plus a VA saw pair (DETUNE 16, CUTOFF 7500) on top

presets.name: Trance Pluck
presets.signature: SUSTAIN 0.05 pluck envelope (DECAY 0.22, FILTER ENV 2.4) with the space carried by PFXS sends only: delay 0.35 / reverb 0.3, inserts bypassed

presets.name: Trance Offbeat Bass
presets.signature: Tightest Daisy ADSR in the pack (D 0.18, S 0.1, R 0.07): offbeat gating by envelope alone

presets.name: Trance Rolling Bass
presets.signature: Rolling bass rebuilt on VA: tight saw pair, CUTOFF 750 with a fast-decaying FILTER ENV 2.6 oct (D 0.085, S 0) and drive 1.4 — the 16th-note filter chatter IS the sound; PolySaw had no filter envelope (audit 2026-11-08)

presets.name: Trance Gate Pad
presets.signature: PWM pad voiced brighter than the Juno pad (CUTOFF 3000, attack 0.25) with CHORUS plus delay send 0.15 in the snapshot

presets.name: Psytrance Bass
presets.signature: Shortest filter gesture in the pack: DECAY 0.09 at SUSTAIN 0 with FILTER ENV 3.2 oct

presets.name: Psytrance Kick
presets.signature: Tightest kick in the pack: DECAY 0.36 with ACCENT 1.0

presets.name: Psy Squelch
presets.signature: RESONANCE 0.96 with ENV AMT 0.92: beyond the 303 recipe (0.88/0.72) on both axes

presets.name: Goa Lead
presets.signature: Dual pulse lead (PW 0.38) at resonance 0.42: neither saw nor square, the pulse pair is the voice

presets.name: Dubstep Growl
presets.signature: Bank patch 20 (GASHAUS, algorithm 28 / feedback 7) pushed with MOD DEPTH 1.7 plus PFXS FOLDER: patch choice recorded as a design decision in the report

presets.name: Hardstyle Kick
presets.signature: Long synth kick (DECAY 0.68, ACCENT 1) with PFXS HARD CLIP at drive 0.65 / ceiling 0.45, mix 1

presets.name: Hard Sync Lead
presets.signature: HARD SYNC on with OSC 2 TUNE +7 st: the sync ratio is the preset (extension E1)

presets.name: CrossMod Metal Bass
presets.signature: CROSS MOD 0.65 (extension E1) on a saw/pulse pair with drive 1.6: oscillator cross-modulation is the metal

presets.name: Alpha Juno Hoover
presets.signature: Per the original Alpha Juno 'What the...' patch: PITCH ENV +12 st over PITCH DECAY 0.5, fast deep PWM (4.0 Hz / 0.4), VCF wide open (CUTOFF 15000, RES 0.05), low pulse sub, plus PFXS CHORUS (audit 2026-11-08)

presets.name: Granular Pad
presets.signature: Grains from POSITION 0.12 (first pitched slice of demo-slices) at SIZE 0.6 with a 0.8 s attack: the slow grain cloud

presets.name: Granular Choir
presets.signature: POSITION 0.55 with SIZE 0.75 / SPREAD 0.7 / JITTER 0.4: larger, wider grains than the Pad from the same material

presets.name: Talking Formant Pad
presets.signature: MODE 0 (FORMANT) with MOD DEPTH 0.35 sweeping the vowel at centre 0.45: the vowel motion is the preset

presets.name: VOSIM Voice
presets.signature: MODE 1 (VOSIM) with FORMANT SHIFT +3 st and SHAPE 0.65: the alternate formant engine mode

presets.name: B-3 + Leslie
presets.signature: The tapered B-3 drawbar set with PFXS ROTARY at SPEED FAST (A 0.5), DRIVE 0.4, mix 0.9: organ and speaker are one preset (extension E5; taper per audit 2026-11-08)

presets.name: Shimmer Reverb Pad
presets.signature: PFXS PITCH SHIFT at +12 st (A 1.0) mixed 0.45 into a slow VA pad with reverb send 0.55: the octave-up wash ships in the preset (extensions E4+E5)
